<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The head row of a hero band: skip link, brand, menu links (the current one carries aria-current), login and a
  call to action.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { NavLink } from "../blocks/nav-bar.types";

export type HeroHeadProps = {
  brand?: string;
  brandHref?: string;
  links?: NavLink[];
  current?: string;
  login?: string;
  loginHref?: string;
  cta?: string;
  href?: string;
  skip?: string;
  navLabel?: string;
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import Link from "../compose/Link.vue";
import LinkPlain from "../compose/LinkPlain.vue";
import MenuEntry from "../components/menu-entry.vue";
import NavBlock from "../components/nav-block.vue";
import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
import { cn, tpl, uniqLabel, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  brand,
  brandHref,
  links,
  current = "",
  login,
  loginHref,
  cta,
  href,
  skip,
  navLabel,
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<HeroHeadProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="header"
    :class="cn('flex w-full flex-wrap items-center justify-between pr-4', defaults.hero.head)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="hero-head"
  >
    <LinkPlain v-if="skip"
      href="#main-content"
      :class="'sr-only focus:not-sr-only focus:fixed focus:left-2 focus:top-2 focus:z-50 focus:rounded focus:bg-background ' +
        'focus:px-4 focus:py-2 focus:text-sm focus:text-foreground focus:inset-ring focus:inset-ring-border'"
      data-slot="skip-link"
    >
      {{ skip }}
    </LinkPlain>
    <MenuEntry
      :href="brandHref"
      :class="cn(defaults.text.small, 'font-medium leading-6 text-background')"
      testid="brand"
    >
      {{ brand }}
    </MenuEntry>
    <NavBlock v-if="(links && ((links?.length ?? 0) > 0))"
      :label="(landmarkLabel ? uniqLabel(tpl('{0}, {1}', navLabel, landmarkLabel)) : navLabel)"
      testid="site-nav"
    >
      <Group gap="8" align="center" class="flex-wrap">
        <template v-for="l in links" :key="l.id">
          <Link v-if="l.href"
            :href="urlOf(l.href)"
            variant="default"
            :aria-current="((l.id === current) ? 'page' : undefined)"
            class="text-xs font-medium leading-5 text-background"
            data-slot="nav-link"
          >
            {{ l.name }}
          </Link>
          <Inline v-else class="text-xs font-medium leading-5 text-background" data-slot="nav-link">
            {{ l.name }}
          </Inline>
        </template>
      </Group>
    </NavBlock>
    <Group gap="2" align="center">
      <Button
        v-if="login"
        :href="urlOf(loginHref)"
        variant="ghost"
        size="sm"
        class="text-background hover:bg-background/10"
      >
        {{ login }}
      </Button>
      <Button v-if="cta" :href="urlOf(href)" variant="secondary" size="sm">
        {{ cta }}
      </Button>
    </Group>
  </Block>
</template>
